experiment_data.hypothesis: Dual-critic (min of two independent critics for actor loss) will suppress CIVO by preventing critic overestimation. Uses 008d CIVO-trigger config (trained dt_emb + multi-rate exposure). If NVE stays below 1.5× and eval matches baseline → dual-critic is an effective architecture-level intervention.
